name: synthesis-playbook
description: AI-assisted recipes for turning workshop outputs into decisions. Companion Claude Code plugin to Bill Bulman's book 'The Synthesis Playbook' (Workshopr facilitation series, Book 6). Bundles the four-moves framework, six workshop-type recipes, and 26 reusable prompts as installable skills with slash commands. Platform-neutral by design — the underlying prompts in prompts/ work in any LLM.
